INSERT INTO metrics_history (
    id, server_name, status, timestamp,
    cpu_usage, memory_usage, disk_usage, network_rx_mb, network_tx_mb, temperature_c, uptime, processes, health_status, health_emoji, summary
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.id }}',
    '{{ $json.server_name }}',
    '{{ $json.status }}',
    '{{ $json.timestamp }}',
    {{ $json.cpu.usage_percent }},
    {{ $json.memory.usage_percent }},
    {{ $json.disk.usage_percent }},
    0,
    0,
    {{ $json.temperature_c }},
    '{{ $json.uptime }}',
    {{ $json.processes }},
    '{{ $json.health_status }}',
    '{{ $json.health_emoji }}',
    '{{ $json.summary }}'
);

INSERT INTO security_metrics (
    id, server_name, timestamp,
    failed_logins, successful_logins, firewall_events,
    blocked_ips, suspicious_users, security_alerts,
    threat_level, authentication_activity, risk_score
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.id }}',
    '{{ $json.server_name }}',
    '{{ $json.timestamp }}',
    0,
    10,
    0,
    0,
    0,
    0,
    '{{ $json.security.threat_level }}',
    10,
    {{ $json.security.risk_score }}
);

SELECT 
    h.server_name,
    h.status,
    h.cpu_usage,
    h.memory_usage,
    h.disk_usage,
    h.temperature_c,
    h.uptime,
    h.health_status,
    h.health_emoji,
    h.summary,
    h.timestamp AS health_timestamp
FROM metrics_history h
ORDER BY h.timestamp DESC
LIMIT 10;
